reason: Round 4 validator found J3b.3 ambiguous at 390px: the Your World subtitle is hidden on phones by design.

changes.before: Expect the URL to become `/world` and the page to show **Your World**, **Journeys** and **Classic Tools**, with no password-change page and no terms page.
changes.after: Expect the URL to become `/world` and the page to show **Journeys** and **Classic Tools**, with no password-change page and no terms page. On desktop the page also shows the **Your World** subtitle; at 390px that subtitle is hidden by design and is not checked.
changes.tracesTo: Change spec requirement that the test member reaches /world with terms accepted and no forced password change; WorldShell.jsx MOBILE_CSS phone-layout decision (lines 115-121).
changes.whyNeeded: Removes the ambiguity the validator raised while keeping the behaviour that matters (landing, no gate pages, tabs visible).

checklist.Not weaker: a changed expected result is: pass: the desktop check on Your World is kept; the 390px check is dropped because the old expectation contradicts the product's documented phone layout (WorldShell.jsx MOBILE_CSS hides .sb-world-brandsub at max-width 700px) and was never required by this feature's change spec, which only requires landing on /world with no password or terms page. The landing, Journeys and Classic Tools checks stay at both sizes.

review.note: Checked against the change spec (no mention of the Your World text) and WorldShell.jsx: the subtitle is hidden below 700px by design. The Career Placement Agents panel the validator saw covering the phone page is not part of this step's expectation; if it hides Journeys or Classic Tools it fails the step as a product defect.
